volume_exception.requester_confirmation: The requester (task owner) chose floors 250 / 150 with the widest scope in this session on 2026-11-04 ('go with this'), after first confirming 280 / 170 on 2026-11-04 and being shown that 280 / 170 is unreachable without padding

evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: linear_list_issues returns state, labels and a truncated description but never comments; the QA observations that decide the call live only in each ticket's comments (Ask_Carriers §6b)
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: labels and state never decide the call: a VFX- or Improvement-labelled ticket can carry a freeze in its comments and a Bug-labelled one can be cosmetic, so a run that skips a ticket's comments mis-calls the unpredictable subset; no filtered search returns comment text

evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: PR search returns merged_at only for PRs whose title or branch names the ticket; half the Done fixes are PRs without the key or direct commits, so each Done ticket's fix has to be traced (branch, PR body, #builds change line) one ticket at a time
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: the ticket's Done state never decides build status: a fix merged after the 18:43Z cut or only in the backend repo is not in the candidate builds, so the trace is needed even when the ticket is Done

evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: re-test reports are spread over #zombie-bugs threads, DMs and #zombie-ops; a channel sweep returns them but not which ticket each refers to, so each ticket's latest result must be matched (counted at 0.1 per ticket: the sweep pages are shared)
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: a developer's fixed note or Done state never decides the QA result column; the latest re-test on the candidate does
